title: Bounded-Diameter Monochromatic Covers
exact_target: For every integer $r\geq2$, does there exist $D(r)$ such that every $r$-edge-colored complete graph can be covered by $r-1$ monochromatic connected subgraphs, each of diameter at most $D(r)$?
